How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Most standard in-stock rugs ship within 1 to 3 business days, with delivery taking 3 to 7 business days. You'll receive your tracking number via email as soon as your order ships.
Custom rugs take longer—typically 4 to 6 weeks for sizes up to 9.5 feet wide, and 12 to 16 weeks for larger custom sizes.
